Starlink coming to EasyJet

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt); megjelent: 2026-10-26T13:03:54+00:00; link: https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2114704574644629903; média: 1 kép]
easyJet has just announced that it will be installing SpaceX's @Starlink on its fleet.

Installations will start in first half of 2027 across the airline’s modern A320, A320neo and A321neo fleet, with the rollout expected to be completed by early 2028.

"easyJet’s investment in onboard connectivity is a key step in further enhancing the experience for 100 million passengers who already choose to fly with the airline each year."

easyJet CEO Kenton Jarvis:
“Innovation is in easyJet’s DNA and partnering with SpaceX to bring Starlink’s high-speed internet connectivity onboard for the first time will not only further enhance the experience we provide millions of customers, but means we are offering more of the options both business and leisure travellers want when they choose who they fly with. Giving customers the opportunity to get online in the air will mean even greater choice and convenience when you fly with easyJet."
